question: What result is assured from a single repetition without any doubt?
premises: One obtains a thousand in one repetition.
The verse explicitly denies doubt in this matter.
The result is stated as certain.
inference: A single repetition is claimed to yield a thousandfold result without doubt.
uncertainties: What is counted as a thousand is not specified.
plain_english: In one repetition one obtains a thousand; there is no doubt about this.
